item.title: CVE-2026-130742 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | Grav 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 resolves Flex sort and filter field names by first calling them as public methods, so a field named delete invokes FlexObject::delete() without any permission check. Authenticated users with only list access can send GET /api/v1/flex-objects/user-accounts?sort=delete requests to delete every account, then use the reopened API first-run setup to create a super admin.

item.title: CVE-2026-130743 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains an insecure blueprint trust vulnerability that allows publisher accounts to read secrets and execute PHP by planting or selecting attacker-controlled blueprint files. Attackers can abuse the import@ directive, uploaded YAML media named as the page template, or form.flash_folder to leak password hashes and keys or invoke static PHP methods for code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-130744 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows page editors to escape the Twig sandbox by sending requests with a Host: pages header. Attackers can write configuration YAML through page folders and media .meta.yaml sidecars to register an unsandboxed Twig namespace and run shell commands as the web server user.

item.title: CVE-2026-130745 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.2
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.2 | Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains an access control bypass vulnerability that allows anonymous visitors to read protected pages because admin and site scopes share a page cache key. Routine editor activity through the API plugin rebuilds the page index without frontmatter.yaml access rules, exposing members-only page content until the cache is rebuilt.

item.title: CVE-2026-130746 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.7
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.7 | Grav before 1.7.53.7 and 2.x before 2.2.18 serves page media files, and rendered pages when lazy sessions are enabled, with the visitor's session cookie and a shared-cacheable Cache-Control header. When a shared cache such as Apache mod_cache stores Set-Cookie responses, an attacker can lure a user signed in through the front-end login to open a media URL with a unique query string, then request that URL to receive the cached session cookie and take over the session.

item.title: CVE-2026-130747 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 9.2
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 9.2 | Grav before 1.7.53.7 and 2.x before 2.2.18 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows anonymous visitors to create super-admin accounts because UserCollection::count() uses an unescaped glob() pattern. On installs whose path contains brackets or a backslash, the account count returns zero, so attackers can send requests to POST /api/v1/auth/setup or the classic admin registration form to create or overwrite administrator accounts.

item.title: CVE-2026-130748 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains a password reset poisoning vulnerability that allows anonymous attackers to redirect reset links by forging the CloudFront-Forwarded-Proto header. Attackers can send a forgot-password request with a crafted scheme value so the emailed reset link points to their host, capturing the token to take over accounts including super admins.

item.title: CVE-2026-130749 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to fill the disk by varying the HTTP Host header. Attackers can send requests with distinct Host values to create per-host compiled configuration, blueprint, language and page index caches, causing session, upload and logging failures.

item.title: CVE-2026-132079 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description:
Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | Insufficient Session Expiration vulnerability in the Apache Iggy Go SDK. The TCP client method CreatePersonalAccessToken wrote the 32-bit expiry into the upper half of the 64-bit expiry field that the server reads. The server read a nonzero expiry as 2^32 times the requested value. A token created through the Go TCP client therefore stayed valid about four billion times longer than the caller asked for.
This issue affects Apache Iggy Go SDK: from 0.5.0 before 0.10.0.
Users are recommended to upgrade to version 0.10.0, which fixes the issue. Tokens that an earlier version created keep their long expiry on the server. Delete those tokens and create new ones.

item.title: CVE-2026-82951 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1 | Latvijas Valsts radio un televīzijas centrs (LVRTC) eParakstītājs 3.0 version 1.10.0-resolute allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to cause HTTP GET requests from a user's workstation by convincing the user to open a crafted signed eDOC file. Automatic certificate validation retrieves a signer-controlled Authority Information Access (AIA) caIssuers URL and follows redirects without restricting the destination, enabling blind SSRF to loopback and private-network services. Additionally, unrestricted loading of local file URIs (such as file:///dev/zero) causes unbounded memory buffering resulting in Denial of Service (OutOfMemoryError). In automated server verification pipelines with UI:N, impact scales up to CVSS 8.6 High.

item.title: CVE-2026-92236 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.1
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.1 | The Asset CleanUp: Page Speed Booster plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Reflected Cross-Site Scripting via 'wpacu_unload_css' and 'wpacu_unload_js' Query Parameters in all versions up to, and including, 1.4.0.6 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that execute if they can successfully trick a user into performing an action such as clicking on a link. Successful exploitation requires that the victim has sufficient privileges to see the plugin's admin-bar entry, typically an administrator.

item.title: CVE-2026-96571 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2 | The FancyBox for WordPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via Comment Anchor 'href' Attribute in all versions up to, and including, 3.4.2 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires the attacker to wrap the payload anchor around a smilie shortcode (e.g., :mrgreen:), which WordPress renders as an <img> element, satisfying the plugin's a:has(img) enrollment selector and disguising the malicious link as an ordinary comment emoticon.

item.title: CVE-2026-109857 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 9.2
item.description:
Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 9.2 | CAST Imaging is vulnerable to authentication bypass in the TenantFilter class. The TenantFilter processes the X-ISSUER-LOCATION HTTP header and dynamically registers an OpenID Connect issuer based on its value. An unauthenticated remote attacker can register a malicious identity provider, create users matching existing administrative usernames, and obtain valid JWTs which will be accepted by the application. This results in complete authentication bypass and privilege escalation to administrative access.
The vulnerability has only been confirmed in version 3.6.2 but may also affect other versions. The vendor did not provide the affected version range, but assured that the vulnerability is fixed "in newer versions".

item.title: CVE-2026-109858 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3
item.description:
Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3 | CAST Imaging has multiple path traversal vulnerabilities in various endpoints. The application does not properly validate the path parameters, allowing an authenticated attacker to use "../" sequences to escape the intended directory and read arbitrary files.
Critically, by reading "/proc/self/environ", the attacker can obtain environment variables containing sensitive credentials such as Keycloak and PostgreSQL passwords, leading to full server compromise and administrative access.
The vulnerability has only been confirmed in version 3.6.2 but may also affect other versions. The vendor did not provide the affected version range, but assured that the vulnerability is fixed "in newer versions".

item.title: CVE-2026-109859 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description:
Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | CAST Imaging has a missing authentication vulnerability in the "/api/auth/keycloak/users/{username}" endpoint. An unauthenticated remote attacker can modify the email address of an arbitrary Keycloak user and access sensitive account information, including the API authentication token hash. This can lead to account takeover, user impersonation and user enumeration.
The vulnerability has only been confirmed in version 3.6.2 but may also affect other versions. The vendor did not provide the affected version range, but assured that the vulnerability is fixed "in newer versions".

item.title: CVE-2026-109860 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3
item.description:
Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3 | CAST Imaging is vulnerable to Path Traversal vulnerability in "/api/server-folders" and "/api/server-folders/download" endpoints. These file-management endpoints accept user-supplied filesystem paths and allow selected system commands to be executed at the specified location, but they do not enforce sufficient authorization boundaries or restrict access to a predefined set of resources. An authenticated attacker can enumerate server directories via the "ls" command and retrieve arbitrary files outside of the intended application workspace, such as "/etc/passwd", exposing sensitive data.
The vulnerability has only been confirmed in version 3.6.2 but may also affect other versions. The vendor did not provide the affected version range, but assured that the vulnerability is fixed "in newer versions".

item.title: CVE-2026-109861 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description:
Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | CAST Imaging contains a hardcoded authentication token in the "KeyCloakController" class of auth-service.jar. An attacker who gains access to the source code, application package, logs, or configuration files can reuse this token to call auth-service endpoints without authentication. Using the token with the "/api/auth/keycloak/users" endpoint, the attacker can enumerate users across Keycloak realms and retrieve user attributes containing API token hashes, enabling reconnaissance and further exploitation.
The vulnerability has only been confirmed in version 3.6.2 but may also affect other versions. The vendor did not provide the affected version range, but assured that the vulnerability is fixed "in newer versions".

item.title: CVE-2026-109863 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3

item.title: CVE-2026-125033 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2 | The Smash Balloon Social Post Feed – Simple Social Feeds for WordPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'attachments.data[].description' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.15.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This makes it possible for unauthenticated outside Facebook users — any party able to contribute an attachment description to a post ingested by the configured feed (visitor posts, shared posts, or attached content) — to plant payloads that execute against every anonymous visitor of any WordPress page carrying the shortcode, requiring no WordPress account whatsoever.

item.title: CVE-2026-127142 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description:
Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | LMS (Lan Management System) is vulnerable to Remote Code Execution via unrestricted upload of dangerous file types in the service ticket feature of the client panel. The application does not verify the type or name of files attached to service tickets. An authenticated attacker can upload an .htaccess file to bypass the access restrictions on the storage directory, together with a PHP script. Visiting the uploaded PHP file's URL leads to arbitrary code execution with the privileges of the web server.
This issue was fixed in commit 89dd3f7.

item.title: CVE-2026-127143 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 9.4
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 9.4 | LMS (Lan Management System) is vulnerable to privilege escalation in the lmsd daemon. The daemon loads the libraries listed in the LMS database without checking that they come from a trusted location. An attacker with access to the web server process or with write access to the LMS database can register a malicious library and trigger a configuration reload, causing lmsd to load and execute it. Because the example systemd unit does not set a separate user, lmsd runs as root, allowing the attacker to execute arbitrary code with root privileges. This issue was fixed in commit 89dd3f7. The lmsd component was removed. For existing installations that use lmsd, the recommended solution is to disable and remove this component.

item.title: CVE-2026-129961 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 9.5
item.description:
Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 9.5 | LMS (Lan Management System) is vulnerable to Remote Code Execution in its e-mail-based Helpdesk ticket intake. The mail parser does not reject Apache .htaccess configuration files or PHP-executable files when saving ticket attachments. A remote unauthenticated attacker can e-mail a Helpdesk ticket with such an attachment; in the default configuration, anyone can request the uploaded file's URL which executes attacker-supplied code with the privileges of the web server process. No operator interaction or LMS client session is required.
The issue was fixed in commit d5059b1.

item.title: CVE-2026-130333 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2 | The SNORDIAN's H5PxAPIkatchu plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'xapi' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 0.4.24 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping.
